mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task_log ( task_id, task_name, prompt, response, session_id, status, error_info, token_usage, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, creator, create_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{prompt}, #{response}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{errorInfo}, #{tokenUsage}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMs}, #{creator}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task_log SET response = #{response}, status = #{status}, error_info = #{errorInfo}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage}, end_time = #{endTime}, duration_ms = #{durationMs} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_task_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
